CURRENT RESEARCH FOCUS

Pancreatic CT Image Analysis & 3D Volumetric Segmentation

Deep learning and Vision Transformer–based architectures for automated pancreatic CT segmentation, class imbalance alleviation, and clinical interpretability.

  • 3D volumetric segmentation utilizing hybrid Vision Transformer and CNN architectures
  • Robust preprocessing and HU windowing for low-contrast soft-tissue pancreas boundaries
  • Post-hoc explainability methods and feature attribution for radiologist validation

An Efficient Scheduling Algorithm Based on Buffer Status and Queue Length to Satisfy the Real-Time Users in 5G

M. H. R. Chayon, Nazmul Hasan Shouvo, M. A. Al Mamun

2024 27th International Conference on Computer and Information Technology (IEEE ICCIT)pp. 2014–2019
Machine LearningArtificial Intelligence
DOI
Abstract

Proposes a dynamic resource allocation scheduling algorithm evaluating buffer status reports and instantaneous queue delays to satisfy strict ultra-reliable low-latency QoS constraints for real-time mobile users in 5G New Radio networks.

2026·conferenceAccepted / In Press

Class-Weighted ResNet50 for Robust Guava Leaf Disease Classification under Real-Field Conditions

Nazmul Hasan Shouvo, M. S. Alom, F. A. Jibon, A. Islam, W. H. Hridoy, A. Rakin, M. I. Ahamed

2026 IEEE International Conference on Quantum Photonics, Artificial Intelligence, and Nanotechnology (IEEE QPAIN)pp. 1–6
Deep LearningExplainable AI (XAI)
Abstract

Agricultural disease diagnosis suffers from extreme class imbalance under uncontrolled ambient lighting and real-field occlusions. We propose a class-weighted ResNet50 framework combined with Grad-CAM visual interpretability to isolate early-stage foliar lesions without synthetic oversampling artefacts.
